# Welcome

The Book of AI is a practical, evolving guide to artificial intelligence: the
models, tools, and ideas shaping the field, with an emphasis on useful
references and hands-on learning.

This book brings together the repository's AI landscape overview, quarterly
Hotplate snapshot, study notes, and glossary. The material is maintained as
Markdown so it can be read on GitHub as well as rendered into a navigable book
with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/).

Use the navigation to explore the current landscape, browse the notes, or look
up terminology in the glossary.
